# Library provenance

XIAO land pattern: [Seeed Studio OPL KiCad Library](https://github.com/Seeed-Studio/OPL_Kicad_Library/blob/master/Seeed%20Studio%20XIAO%20Series%20Library/XIAO-nRF52840-Plus-SMD.kicad_mod), retrieved 2026-11-16. Original SHA-256: `8f33096330333bc797e408f9097ba88aace2455f27228195304c76cf08331350`. License: **CC BY-SA 4.0**, copyright Seeed Studio, retained in [CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt](CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt). The copper geometry (29 pad positions, sizes, rotations, layers) also matches the official [XIAO footprint ZIP](https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/XIAO-KiCad-Library/New_XIAO_Series_Footprints.zip).

Changes: local library name, reference/value fields, component outlines moved from silkscreen to fabrication layer; copper geometry retained. Original symbols in this project were drawn from pin/function facts; vendor schematic artwork was not copied. The finished PCB and its embedded land patterns are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0; this does not change the license of the enclosure, decals or font.

Other project footprints derive from the KiCad 10.0.8 standard footprint libraries, retaining their package geometry and moving silk outlines to Fab. KiCad libraries use [CC BY-SA 4.0 with the KiCad libraries exception](https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/), permitting use in PCB designs. Copyright KiCad library contributors. Any local footprint copies retain that library license and exception. Software scripts are MIT.

Manufacturer datasheets are linked in ../docs/REFERENCES.md; they are not relicensed or copied into this library.
